Draft Plan of Subdivision | Zoning By Law Amendment — The proposed development contemplates a total of 207 townhouse dwelling units, comprising 155 street townhouse units, 52 dual-frontage townhouse units and a medium-density block. In addition to the residential component, the plan includes an elementary school block and a dedicated block to protect and preserve the existing Natural Heritage System.
Lifting of Hold — Lifting of Holding Symbol Application

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment to permit a proposed phased commercial development consisting of two six-storey hotels, namely one Home 2 Hotel and one Hampton Inn Hotel, including a total of 199 guest rooms. Site Access is proposed via Airport Road.

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — The subject applications are to permit the development of a two-storeys commercial plaza comprising of a mix of office daycare, and general retail uses. A single building has been designed to orient toward Wanless Drive, with parking located primarily to the side and rear of the building to support an attractive streetscape and efficient site circulation.

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — The proposal contemplates the redevelopment of the Subject Property to accommodate a high-rise residential building and the relocation and reconstruction of the existing place of worship. The residential component consists of a 35-storey apartment building with a podium form and step-back levels, comprising approximately 416 residential units in a range of unit sizes and tenures, together with indoor and outdoor amenity areas for residents. The proposal also includes the relocation and redevelopment of the church facility on the southern port…

Zoning By Law Amendment — Temporary Use Zoning By-law Amendment, to permit open storage including Truck Parking consisting of 132 trailer parking bays measured at 20 metres by 4.5 metres and 225 automobile parking spaces measured at 6 metres by 3 metres.

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — This project seeks to complete an infill development of three (3) new Commercial Buildings within the existing SmartCentres Shopping Centre with a total GFA of 287,629.3 SF (26,720.81 Sqm), on the remaining vacant pieces of land. Building B1 is a 2-storey building at the Gateway Corner of Mayfield Road and Bramalea Road with a GFA of 24,490 SF (2,275.12 Sqm), Building B2 is a 2-storey building with a GFA of 21,243.3 SF (1,973.5 Sqm), and Building A has a GFA of 154,517 SF (14,355 Sqm). A future Mid-rise Residential building will be proposed i…

Zoning By Law Amendment — The proposal includes a residential townhouse development containing a total of 76 units. This includes 61 units as traditional street townhouses, and 15 units as dual frontage townhouses. A total of 168 parking spaces are proposed, of which 16 are visitor parking, and one is barrier free.

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — The redevelopment of the subject site for a multi-unit commercial plaza anchored by a Panchvati grocery store. Building A will have a total GFA of 296.75 square metres, and Building B will have a total GFA of 1,341.75 square metres.

records.address: 55-61 Beech Street and 132-142 Church Street East
records.description: Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — City initiated Zoning By-law amendment to permit 104 back to back stacked townhouses

Lifting of Hold — To lift the Holding provision to permit an industrial development includes a truck wash / truck repair, gas bar, convenience store and warehouse development on the Subject Lands. The proposed warehouse will have a Gross Floor Area of approximately 1,174 square metres (12,637 square feet), with access to provided from Goreway Drive, Intermodal Drive and Deerhurst Drive. The address of the property was formerly known as 0 Goreway Drive.

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — The applications seek approval to permit the development of a place of worship (1,445 m²), a private school (13,050 m²), associated outdoor amenities including a soccer field and track and field loop, as well as associated parking.
Zoning By Law Amendment — Renewal of Temporary Zoning By-law Amendment.

Draft Plan of Subdivision | Zoning By Law Amendment — Draft Plan of Subdivision and Zoning By-law Amendment which seek to re-zone and subdivide the Subject Lands to permit a proposed mixed-use residential development consisting of two (2) development blocks and one (1) road widening with daylight triangle block and a 0.3metre reserve block. The Draft Plan of Subdivision will accommodate phased development of the Subject Lands consisting of a 12-Storey Apartment Building with 181 Apartment Dwelling Units, 9 ground floor Commercial Office Units, 52 Townhome Dwellings and 2 Semi-Detached Dwelling…
Lifting of Hold — Removal of Holding Provision.

Draft Plan of Subdivision — Application for an outstanding Draft Plan of Subdivision within the Gore Meadows West precinct to facilitate the development of ~149.5 residential dwelling units in the form of single detached dwellings and a medium density mixed use block.

Draft Plan of Subdivision | Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — The applications will facilitate the comprehensive redevelopment of the approximately 20-acre subject site with a new mixed-use community, which will include residential, commercial, retail and daycare uses, a significant amount of publicly accessible open space, and a new public street system. The site is located within a Major Transit Station Area and will support 13 buildings, ranging in height from 8 to 44 storeys. In total, the proposed development would have a gross floor area (GFA) of 374,705 square metres, …

Draft Plan of Subdivision | Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — To permit a development consisting of one 10-storey mixed-use apartment building for 162 residential units with commercials at grade, along with 3 stacked townhouse blocks for 48 stacked units. 225 square metres of commercial space is proposed on the ground floor of the apartment building.

Zoning By Law Amendment — 8550 Goreway Portfolio Inc. and Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited are proposing to legalize and permit outside storage on the portions of the subject lands currently zoned M4 – Section 1606, M4 – Section 1641 and M4 – Section 1574. In addition, the proposal includes permitting the stacking of shipping containers, ranging from two (2) to four (4) containers in height, on limited portions of the subject lands. The proposal contemplates the stacking of approximately 452 shipping containers within “Yard B,” approximately 2,139 shipping containers within “Yard F,” and app…

Official Plan Amendment | Zoning By Law Amendment — To redevelop the Subject Lands with two (2) buildings containing heights of 42 and 32 storeys.
